decisions.reason: As a newly launched resin injection unit in a core application area, it is still an unresolved option worth keeping, though overlap with other recent launches raises some portfolio-prioritization risk.

This second resin injection unit is also close to the firm's established capabilities and customers, so absent clear failure signals the option value of waiting outweighs the short-term carrying cost.

An automatic airless spray gun fits the firm's core spray-equipment business, and for a medium-sized machinery firm the cost of continuing to offer it for another year is likely low relative to the value of learning market acceptance.
A manual airless spray gun is highly aligned with the firm's established product range and channels, so management would likely keep it while demand uncertainty continues to resolve.
Because this air-assisted airless spray gun is a full product line in the firm's core market, its strategic fit and reusable sales/service support make near-term withdrawal unlikely.
The data logger is a somewhat more exploratory digital add-on, but it supports the firm's innovation direction and likely has modest carrying costs, so the option is still worth retaining for now.
